crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, on man…
Let their way be dark and slippery, Yahweh’s angel pursuing them.
He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.
He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.
The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
The wise man’s eyes are in his head, and the fool walks in darkness—and yet I perceived that one event happens to them…
for it comes in vanity, and departs in darkness, and its name is covered with darkness.
They will pass through it, very distressed and hungry. It will happen that when they are hungry, they will worry, and…
and look to the earth, and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.
Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.
When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.
For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness…
These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm; for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds…
wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been…
The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues…
and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They didn’t repent of their works.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.”
translations.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward heaven, so that darkness may spread over the land of Egypt—a palpable darkness.”
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Stretch out thy hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.
